msg: MinIO server image (minio/minio, AGPLv3; GitHub repo archived, community edition now source-only)
fix: image: rustfs/rustfs:1.0.1  (Apache-2.0; S3 port 9000, console 9001; copy objects over the S3 API, do not remount the MinIO data dir)
use the RustFS rc client (package rustfs-client) or any S3 CLI pointed at http://rustfs:9000
helm repo add rustfs https://charts.rustfs.com && helm install rustfs rustfs/rustfs --version 1.0.1
image: rustfs/rustfs:1.0.1, or chart rustfs 1.0.1 from https://charts.rustfs.com
repository: https://charts.rustfs.com  with  name: rustfs  version: 1.0.1
RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY=<same value>  (the RustFS default rustfsadmin is public; always set it)

msg: Legacy MinIO key variable MINIO_ACCESS_KEY / MINIO_SECRET_KEY

fix: RUSTFS_VOLUMES=/data/rustfs{0..3}  (same expansion syntax as the RustFS sample compose)
drop the command; set RUSTFS_VOLUMES=/data, RUSTFS_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0:9000, RUSTFS_CONSOLE_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0:9001, RUSTFS_CONSOLE_ENABLE=true

msg: MinIO server-side encryption key variable (MINIO_KMS_* / MINIO_KES_*): objects MinIO encrypted are not readable by RustFS
fix: copy objects out decrypted over the S3 API before cutover; then set a RustFS KMS backend (Vault KV2/Transit or AWS KMS)

msg: Legacy MinIO binary download (dl.min.io): these binaries will not receive updates
fix: image: rustfs/rustfs:1.0.1, or a RustFS release binary from https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/releases

msg: Terraform provider aminueza/minio speaks the MinIO admin API
fix: for buckets use hashicorp/aws with endpoints { s3 = "http://rustfs:9000" } and s3_use_path_style = true
